description: Replace your passport bearer token (for example after it leaked). The old token stops working at once; the new token is returned ONCE, so update your Authorization header right away. Needs a request signed with a passport key: a token (header or passport_token) is refused with signature_required, so a leaked token can never do this. A passport your MCP app signed in for has no bearer token and never gets one (app_sign_in_only): the app keeps the sign-in, out of your context.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.

name: rotate_token
title: Replace my bearer token
